Separate from this switch: while a subscription key is entered, RoomVox also reports the key, the installation identifier and the number of rooms, room groups, user accounts and disabled accounts to licenses.voxcloud.nl, so the subscription can be checked and seats counted. That report is part of the subscription and stops when the key is removed.
